messages.english: Record elevation benchmarks separately from the terrain model in your site survey.
messages.translation: Tsala swikombiso swa ku tlakuka hi ku hambana na xifaniso xa mbango eka nkambisiso wa xitsha xa wena.

messages.english: Fetch a solar reference and record wind evidence with its height and source.
messages.translation: Kuma xikombo xa dyambu u tlhela u tsala vumbhoni bya moya na ku tlakuka ka wona na xihlovo.

messages.english: Your site → Site survey → Land & Location
messages.translation: Xitsha xa wena → Nkambisiso wa xitsha → Misava na Ndhawu

messages.english: Open your site survey to check the terrain reference and add a separately sourced elevation benchmark.
messages.translation: Pfula nkambisiso wa xitsha xa wena ku kambela xikombo xa mbango u tlhela u engetela xikombiso xa ku tlakuka lexi humaka eka xihlovo lexi hambaneke.

messages.english: Your site → Site survey → Resources & Inputs
messages.translation: Xitsha xa wena → Nkambisiso wa xitsha → Switirhisiwa na Swongheriwana

messages.english: Review the reference solar assumptions and record wind height, source and period before saving.
messages.translation: Kambisisa miehleketo ya xikombo xa dyambu u tlhela u tsala ku tlakuka ka moya, xihlovo na nkarhi u nga si hlayisa.
